db_select_table: Select a table and click Load
settings_chart_type_hint: Choose how the main chart is displayed.
confirm_delete_user: Are you sure you want to delete user
zeep_hint: Upload the Zeep Life export ZIP and enter the password from the email. Daily steps from ACTIVITY.csv will be imported into the app.
zeep_ready_hint: Check the archive and password, then click Continue to start import.
zeep_err_state: Import is not ready yet — refresh the page and try again
zeep_err_rows: No valid step data to import
zeep_confirm_sub: Review daily steps from the archive before importing into the app.
zeep_preview_empty: No step data found in the archive.
zeep_guide_title: How to export Zeep Life data
zeep_notif_body: Open the Zeep Life tab to continue import.
worker_stop_confirm: Unprocessed results will be discarded. Stop the background task?
takeout_hint: Select a Google Takeout zip (Google Fit, daily activity or step data). Data is written into your app database after processing.
takeout_guide_title: How to create a Google Takeout archive
video_phone_guide_title: Prepare the steps chart on your phone (for recording)
takeout_err_none: No step data found in the archive
takeout_err_worker: The import process did not start
takeout_conflict_question: Data already exists for {n} days. Overwrite existing values?
video_analysis_hint: Upload a video, adjust crop if needed, then start.
video_confirm_sub: Add these values to your counter or close without adding.
video_none_recognized: No step values were recognized in the video.
video_err_ffmpeg: Could not read video or extract frames
video_frame_error: Could not load a preview frame from the video
year_error: Enter a year from 2000 to 2100, or -
video_err_upload: Failed to save the uploaded file
video_err_dir: Could not create a work folder
video_err_worker: The background task did not start
video_err_busy: Another analysis is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
video_err_stale_job: This job is no longer active (no recent progress). Start a new analysis if needed.
video_remote_hint: Analysis is running in the background on the server. You can close the app on other devices; open this again to see progress.
video_gaps_sub: Calendar days from the first to the last recognized date that have no row or were not read. Enter steps, then add them to the list before importing.
video_gaps_empty: No gaps in this date range — every day has a row.
video_notif_body: Recognition has finished. The results are not in the app until you add or discard them. Open the video dialog to continue, or close this alert to be reminded no sooner than in 12 hours.
feature_steps_tracking: Track your daily steps with detailed statistics
feature_visualization: Visualize data with interactive charts (bar and line charts)
feature_calendar_view: Calendar view with goal achievement indicators
feature_multiple_views: Multiple view modes: Year, Month, and Week
feature_data_types: Different data types: Steps, Distance, and Calories
feature_excel_editor: Excel-like table editor for managing your data
feature_backup_system: Automatic backup system with restore functionality
hotkey_enter: Press Enter to save edited cell
hotkey_delete: Press Delete to clear selected cells
hotkey_ctrl_a: Ctrl+A to select all cells in Excel view
hotkey_ctrl_s: Ctrl+S to save changes in Excel view
hotkey_shift_select: Hold Shift to select multiple cells
excel_edit: Double-click any cell to edit its value
excel_select: Click and drag to select multiple cells
excel_manage: Manage backups directly from the Excel view
excel_restore: Restore data from any backup point
confirm_delete_cells_message: Data in the selected cells will be permanently deleted.
restore_replaces_data: Current data will be replaced with data from the backup. An automatic backup will be created before restoring.
import_replace_notice: All current data will be replaced with data from the imported file. A backup will be created before importing.
mobile_app_feature_sync_desc: Automatically sync your steps with Health Connect on Android.
mobile_app_feature_qr_desc: Scan a QR code to pair the app with this dashboard in seconds.
mobile_app_feature_secure_desc: Use a generated token for secure, password-free authentication.
mobile_app_feature_offline_desc: Track steps even without an internet connection.
mobile_app_feature_devices_desc: Sync data from multiple wearables and fitness trackers.
mobile_app_feature_widget_desc: Add a step counter widget to your phone's home screen.
mobile_app_scan_desc: Open the app and scan this code to sync instantly.
manual_pair_intro: If QR scanning is not available, connect the app manually:
manual_pair_step1: Install and open the StepMonitor app on your phone.
manual_pair_step2: Copy the connection link and the token below.
manual_pair_step3: In the app, open "Connect to AppDashboard" and paste the link, replacing the token part with your token (or paste the link directly — it already contains the token).
manual_pair_generate_first: Generate a QR code first — the token will appear here.
info_card_mobile_text: Install the companion Android app to sync steps and health data from your phone to this dashboard.
